nom: La Roche-Posay Effaclar Purifying Foaming Gel Cleanser for Oily Skin

segments.oily: Most oily-skin reviewers report reduced shine and a clean, non-greasy feel, though a notable minority describe severe dryness, burning, or breakouts within days of use.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers are split: some report the cleanser is surprisingly non-drying when paired with a moisturizer, while others (including normally oily users) say it left their skin flaky, patchy, and painful.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers generally report a clean, non-stripped feel and good balance between oily and dry areas, with several calling it their preferred cleanser for this skin type.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are divided: several say it is gentle, non-irritating, and even soothes rosacea, while others report allergic-type reactions, redness, itching, and swelling.
segments.mature: One mature-skin reviewer credits it, alongside a basic routine, for youthful-looking skin, but this is a single, thin data point.

concerns.aging: Only one reviewer references aging skin, crediting the cleanser and a simple routine for a youthful look; too little data to generalize.
concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers report the cleanser caused significant dryness, flakiness, burning, or barrier damage, especially with continued use; a smaller group says it did not dry them out at all and even worked well on normally dry skin.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers describe new redness, red spots, or burning around the nose and eyes; one reviewer with rosacea reports no reaction and calls it gentle.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer reports the cleanser damaged their skin barrier over time, causing persistent flakiness and burning that did not resolve.
concerns.spots: Reviewers with blackheads or dark spots/scarring report visible improvement in texture and evenness with continued use; no dissent noted on this specific point.
concerns.blemishes: The majority of acne-prone reviewers report reduced breakouts, smaller pimples, and fewer cystic flare-ups over weeks to months; however, several reviewers report the opposite — new cystic or clustered breakouts, especially around the mouth and nose, shortly after starting use.
concerns.oiliness: Most oily-skin reviewers report noticeably less shine and oil production over time; a few say results plateaued after initial improvement.

aspects.libelle: Large bottle lasts a long time
Feels stripping or harsh over time

extraits.texte: This cleanser destoyed my skin barrier over time. Dried out my skin and now its flakey itchy dry and burns. It also never cleared any of my acne.

extraits.titre: Broke me out like never before
extraits.texte: I have oily skin and struggle a lot with acne, however I've rarely suffered any breakouts from skincare products I've tried in the past. This product was the exception. After using it for a week or so I started experiencing the most painful breakout above my lips (area right under my nose). The pimples even came in clusters!! It was horrible, and as soon as I stopped using this specific product and went back to my previous cleanser my face cleared up. Not to mention the smell was also disgusting. Will never purchase again :(

i have very bad acne prone oily skin and have struggle with my skin for years. I have heard so much about this brand so I decided to try it out. After about a week of using this my skin is very irritated and extremely dry and painful on my upper cheeks. I was so hopeful.
I have rosacea and this wash doesn't affect me at all. Works beautifully and gentle ! Never break out from it like with other products! I have my teenage daughter using it also !! Fantastic!!

I have oily,acne-prone/sensitive skin. This cleanser is incredible. In 2 washes, my acne decreased (yes, i'm still shocked). After washing, your skin will feel soft & clean but not stripped. It also makes my skin bright after washing. It's helping my skin with blackheads & overall texture.Oh, make sure to moisturize after bc it can be a lil bit drying but not too much. No irritations/allergies. Overall, so far it's an incredible cleanser & I hope with continued use, I will see the full benefits. I love how it doesn't contain active ingredients (bha/aha etc.) I hope you don't change the ingredients bc it is already perfect. Final thoughts: This cleanser doesn't contain active ingredients but it works SO WELL. It's so rare to find a acne/oily cleanser without active ingredients that doesn't strip your skin and it actually works to reduce acne/oily skin it so this cleanser is definitely worth a try!!! I'm still waiting for full benefits though (been using for over a week so I need more time for it to fully kick in) But so far so good! I love it and if this continues to work well on my skin, i'll probs use this until the end of time. Again, please don't change ingredients. Thank you LRP.

extraits.titre: This Facewash - Must buy for Oily skin
extraits.texte: This face wash is the best i could find out there. my skin is oily and sesnitive at the same time. I do get breakouts here and there randomly. With some redness on the face along with sensitive skin, finfing the right face washwash was a challenge. This is the best face wash, doesnt dry out my skin after the wash, skin feels clean, refreshed and supple. I love the clear gel texture of the facewash. If you talk about the price , its definatley worth it as it goes a long way. Value for money yes, and gentle to the skin. It doesnt irritates my skin after the wash and has mild fragrance. Afterusing this face wash for about 6 months i could feel the diffrence in my skin.

extraits.titre: Effective Cleanser for Oily Skin Only
extraits.texte: Great for oily skin like me. It cleans thoroughly, but follow up with a hydrating moisturizer. Not for dry or normal skin; this isn't a one-size-fits-all on all skin types. If you have sensitive skin, avoid. Best cleanser I've used.
